budget_states.title: Variable budget
budget_states.description: Pick the entity whose state chooses the budget and press Submit to list its states, then enter the budget for each. device_unavailable.title: Entity unavailable for balancing
device_unavailable.description: The configured entity {entity_id} is unavailable, so Power Load Balancer cannot use it for balancing. Check the entity state and availability, or remove it from this integration's configuration if it is no longer used.

device_not_controllable.title: Media player cannot be controlled
device_not_controllable.description: The configured media player {entity_id} does not support turning on or off. Power Load Balancer will not be able to control it for balancing. Choose a different media player or remove it from the configuration if it should not be managed.

entity_not_registered.title: Entity configured for balancing does not exist
entity_not_registered.description: Power Load Balancer is configured to use {entity_id}, but no such entity exists in this Home Assistant. Nothing is broken in the house -- the configuration names something that is not here, so balancing simply ignores it. Open the integration's options and either point this row at an entity that exists, or remove the row. This will not clear on its own.
